repo_notes.content: Write every wiki page, including titles, body text, tables, and diagram labels, in Japanese (日本語). Keep code, file paths, attribute names, and command names in their original English form. This repository is auro-button, the accessible button Web Component of Alaska Airlines' Auro Design System.
